mapper.select: select count(1) as totalPlans, coalesce(sum(case when f.status in (4, 5) and d.has_adjust = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as orderedPlans, coalesce(sum(case when f.status in (4, 5) and d.has_adjust = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as adjustedPlans from ( select l.target_id as plan_id, max(case when l.action = 'restock.adjust' then 1 else 0 end) as has_adjust from agent_decision_log l where l.del_flag = '0' and l.target_type = 'plan' and l.action in ('restock.confirm', 'restock.adjust', 'restock.skip') and l.result = 1 and l.create_time >= #{windowStart} and l.create_time <= #{windowEnd} group by l.target_id ) d join agent_restock_plan f on f.id = cast(d.plan_id as unsigned) where f.del_flag = '0' and f.status in (3, 4, 5)

select count(1) as totalPlans, coalesce(sum(case when llm_calibrated is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unknownPlans, coalesce(sum(case when llm_calibrated = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as uncalibratedPlans from agent_restock_plan where del_flag = '0'
and plan_date >= DATE(#{windowStart}) and plan_date <= DATE(#{windowEnd})

select count(1) as calls, coalesce(sum(tokens_in), 0) as tokensIn, coalesce(sum(tokens_out), 0) as tokensOut, coalesce(sum(tokens_in), 0) + coalesce(sum(tokens_out), 0) as tokensTotal, case when count(1) = 0 then null else round(avg(latency_ms), 0) end as avgLatencyMs from agent_message where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{windowStart} and create_time <= #{windowEnd}

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, count(1) as calls, coalesce(sum(tokens_in), 0) + coalesce(sum(tokens_out), 0) as tokensTotal from agent_message where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{windowStart} and create_time <= #{windowEnd} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by statDate asc

select count(1) as runs, coalesce(sum(case when status in ('failed', 'interrupted') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failedRuns from agent_run where del_flag = '0' and status in ('done', 'failed', 'interrupted') and started_at >= #{windowStart} and started_at <= #{windowEnd}

select count(1) as pendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when timestampdiff(minute, coalesce(update_time, create_time), now()) >= #{thresholdMinutes} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as overThreshold, coalesce(max(timestampdiff(minute, coalesce(update_time, create_time), now())), 0) as oldestWaitMinutes from agent_restock_plan where del_flag = '0' and status in (1, 2, 6) and plan_date >= DATE(#{windowStart}) and plan_date <= DATE(#{windowEnd})

select n as n, mean_delta_pct as meanDeltaPct, median_delta_pct as medianDeltaPct, plan_date as planDate, generated_at as generatedAt from agent_compare_report
order by generated_at desc, id desc limit 1
